# ECO-SPARK-PATCH — Project-local Spark DSL extensions via dsl_patches

Research finding 3 (high confidence, 3-0): Spark is the DSL engine behind every Ash-ecosystem DSL including Reactor's (ash_pplan pins spark ~> 2.7 as a direct dependency precisely because Reactor step DSLs are Spark-based); its extension points - sections, entities, transformers, verifiers - and end-user extensibility via dsl_patches/extensions are the lever for project-local extension without forking. This order answers openQuestion 4: whether ash_pplan should expose project-specific Spark DSL sections for its P-PLAN/PROV-O domain instead of composing existing DSLs verbosely at call sites, decided on a measured call-site census.
